fields.Name: Integration Test: RLS Mixed Filtered
fields.Description: Integration-test-only role for the rls-isolation mixed-role checks (RLS12/RLS13). Grants READ on 'MJ: User Roles' bound to the 'Integration Test: Own Rows by UserID' Row-Level-Security filter, and nothing else. Paired with 'Integration Test: RLS Mixed Unfiltered' on the seeded it-rls-mixed user. Safe to delete; assign only to that test account.

fields.Name: Integration Test: RLS Mixed Unfiltered
fields.Description: Integration-test-only role for the rls-isolation mixed-role checks (RLS12/RLS13). On 'MJ: User Roles' it holds an UNFILTERED Allow row that grants Create but not Read, and a Deny row on Create that cancels it. The Allow row must not lift the read filter of 'Integration Test: RLS Mixed Filtered' (it grants no read), and the Deny row must win the permission gate, so the it-rls-mixed user ends with a filtered read and no create. Safe to delete; assign only to that test account.
